intro: WE Invoice is developed by White Eagles & Co. s. r. o. (“we”). By using the app you agree to these terms. They are short, because we have nothing to hide.

blocks.p: The app is free for everyone, with no limits on the number of companies, documents, contacts or users, no trial period and no paid tiers. It requires no registration with us. We reserve the right to change the app or stop developing it at any time; your data stays with you and you can export it whenever you like.

sections.h2: You are responsible for your tax documents

blocks.p: The app helps you issue documents, keep records and prepare reports. The user is responsible for the accuracy, completeness and timely issue of invoices, for archiving them, for the content of tax returns and reports, and for filing them. We update rates, deadlines and legal texts in the app with every release, but check that they apply to your case.
WE Invoice does not replace an accountant or a tax adviser. When in doubt, consult a professional.

E-invoices are sent and received through a certified provider with whom you have your own contract. The provider is responsible for its availability, pricing and compliance with legal obligations. The same applies to Google Drive, banks and other third-party services you connect in the app.
The e-invoicing feature is in closed beta. We may restrict or end access granted by an invitation code if the stability of the service requires it.
By joining the waiting list you agree to receive e-mails about the e-invoicing beta. You can unsubscribe via the link in every e-mail. Details are in the [privacy policy](./privacy.html).
